name: BP Mutual Friends
author: SuitePlugins

sections.description: List users’ mutual friends in BuddyPress easily. One click install and setup.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit ‘Plugins > Add New’
  2. Search for ‘BP Mutual Friends’
  3. Activate BP Mutual Friends from your Plugins page.

From WordPress.org

  1. Download BP Mutual Friends.
  2. Upload the ‘bp-mutual-friends’ directory to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory, using your favorite method (ftp, sftp, scp, etc…)
  3. Activate BP Mutual Friends from your Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Is BuddyPress required?

Yes! BuddyPress is required to use this plugin.
